winks.rationale: The word 'Cairo' is itself a well-known US town (Cairo, Illinois; also Cairo, Georgia).
'Mexico' is the exact name of a US town (Mexico, Missouri; also Mexico, New York).
'Brazil' is the exact name of a US city (Brazil, Indiana, county seat of Clay County).
'Milan' is the exact name of many US towns (Milan, Tennessee; Milan, Ohio; Milan, Michigan).
'Egypt' names several small US communities and an Egypt, Texas.
'China' is the exact name of US towns (China, Maine; China, Texas).
'Sudan' is the exact name of a US town (Sudan, Texas).
'Walden' is the exact name of a US town (Walden, Colorado, county seat of Jackson County).
'Concord' is the exact name of many US places (Concord, NH capital; Concord, MA; Concord, CA).
'Athena' is the exact name of a US town (Athena, Oregon).
'Reed' appears in US place names such as Reed City, Michigan and Reeds Spring, Missouri.
'Barton' is the exact name of a US town (Barton, Vermont; also Barton, North Dakota).
'West' is the exact name of a US town (West, Texas).
'Carlos' is the exact name of a US town (Carlos, Minnesota).
